note: all-day events; end dates are exclusive. lat/lng geocoded from location (OpenStreetMap Nominatim, cached in data/geocode-cache.json; geo_precision place|town; missing = not mapped). type = oneoff|yearly|weekly|monthly (from the RRULE FREQ; daily counts as weekly). regular = daily/weekly/monthly recurring events (e.g. markets) listed once with a readable rule, times, next date and active months instead of being expanded. holidays = Republic of Ireland public holidays (actual dates, no substitute days)

events.description:
Tuesday 1 December 2026, 9:00am–4:00pm, at West Square, Macroom. Annual free Christmas market. Market hours are from the IOMST listing (updated 4 November 2026). Cork County Council public notice TRC-164-2026 confirms the date, West Square location and that it is a free Christmas market, but only gives the road-closure window, not the market hours: 

The road closure was a proposed temporary closure, with objections due by 5pm on Wednesday 11 November 2026, so this date remains subject to confirmation. If weather is unsuitable, the listed alternative dates are Tuesday 8 December or Tuesday 15 December 2026 (not entered as separate events).

Sunday 6 December: Éigse Mass 11:00am, Séipéal Ghobnatan, Cúil Aodha, broadcast live on RTÉ Raidió na Gaeltachta; recital 12:00pm, Sean-Teampall Reilig Ghobnatan, Baile Bhuirne, with Hammy Hamilton and the Ora Quartet. End times are not stated.
